title: valeriana longifolia var. pilosa
intro: Valeriana longifolia var. pilosa, commonly known as a type of valerian, is a plant species that belongs to the family Valerianaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as improving sleep quality, reducing anxiety and stress, and acting as a natural sedative. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to interact with the GABA receptors in the brain, promoting relaxation and reducing muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Valeriana longifolia var. pilosa include valerenic acid, valeranone, and isovaltrate, which are responsible for its sedative and anxiolytic properties.
